items.title: Maths confidence
items.body: From counting and addition to fractions and times tables, our games build number skills step by step — at exactly the right pace for your child's age.

items.title: Spelling & phonics
items.body: Phonics games, spelling bees, and word hunts help children recognise patterns, build vocabulary, and spell with confidence.

items.title: Reading comprehension

safetySection.heading: Your child's safety is our priority

points.text: No advertising or sponsored content — ever
No social features or chat between children
Fully compliant with UK GDPR and Children's Privacy law
No personal data collected from children
Parent account controls all child profiles

faq.question: What age is Sodafom suitable for?
faq.answer: Sodafom is designed for children aged 5 to 13. Content is split into three age groups — 5–7, 8–10, and 11–13 — so your child always gets activities matched to their level.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: Sodafom costs just £1 per month or £10 per year — less than a cup of coffee. You can cancel any time, and there are no hidden fees or in-app purchases.

faq.question: Is there a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes — you can explore the games and subjects for free before subscribing. Simply create an account and start playing.

faq.question: Can I track my child's progress?
faq.answer: Absolutely. The Parent & Teacher Hub gives you a full view of your child's activity — which subjects they've practised, their scores, time spent learning, and stars earned.

faq.question: Is Sodafom aligned with the UK curriculum?
faq.answer: Yes. All content is mapped to the KS1 and KS2 national curriculum, covering the core skills children need at school.

faq.question: Can teachers use Sodafom too?
faq.answer: Yes — teachers can create accounts and monitor class progress through the Hub. It works great as a homework tool or classroom supplement.
